traces for recommendationservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 1.04->2.57ms (2.48x), errors 0.0->0.0; inbound calls self-time p50 3.88->5.43ms (1.4x), errors 0.0->0.0

alternatives_rejected.why: Pure delay injection would not explain a 655.6% CPU rise (z=67.44) alongside the latency spike; own self-time rose 2.48x, consistent with CPU contention (E1, E2).

frontend latency-50 rose only 29.5% (z=5.89), versus recommendationservice latency-90 at 867.2% (E1); caller-observed latency into recommendationservice rose 1.4x (E2), so frontend is downstream of the fault, not its source.

proposed_fix.description: Find and stop the CPU-hogging process or workload in the recommendationservice pod. Temporarily scale out recommendationservice replicas and raise its CPU limit to restore latency, then confirm CPU and p90 latency return to baseline.
